title: KGContext
description: KG subgraph extracted around the target event asset. Output of Step 5B. Defines the structural search space for causal candidate generation.

subgraph_id.description: Stable ID for this subgraph snapshot — referenced by evidence_bundle retrieval_scope and causality_candidates.

kg_snapshot_version.description: Version or timestamp of the KG at query time. Required for reproducibility — RCA must be replayable against the KG state that existed at event time.

hop_limit.description: Maximum hops used to expand the neighborhood. Configurable per system type.

components.description: Component nodes in the subgraph realized by the event asset and its neighbors.

role.description: Functional role of this component in the system (e.g., pressure_boundary, heat_transfer_surface).

relation_to_asset.description: Topological relationship of this component to the event asset.

seed_match_type.description: Development/runtime provenance for why this component was included (e.g., seed, telemetry).

hop_distance.description: Graph hop distance from the event asset.

edge_types_traversed.description: KG edge types traversed to reach this component.

maximo_floc.description: Maximo Functional Location (FLOC) code stored on the KG element_usage node. Used by CAPExportSerializer for functional_location resolution.

sap_equipment_id.description: SAP PM Equipment ID stored on the KG element_usage node. Used by CAPExportSerializer for equipment_id resolution.

upstream_paths.description: Explicit upstream causal paths from neighbor components to the event asset.

nodes.description: Ordered list of KG node IDs from upstream cause to event asset.

edge_attributes.description: Edge-level temporal or capacity attributes (e.g., install_date, flow_capacity).

path_strength.description: Estimated causal path strength (0–1) based on hop count and edge type composition.

downstream_paths.description: Downstream propagation paths — components that could be affected by or have been affected by the event. Mirrors upstream_paths structure.

failure_modes.description: FMEA failure mode nodes mapped to components in the subgraph.

fm_id.description: Canonical failure mode ID in the KG.

component_name.description: Human-readable name of the component this failure mode applies to.

causal_category.description: Authoritative causal category letter (A–L) for scoring profile dispatch. Takes precedence over runtime keyword inference when present.

causal_category_source.description: How causal_category was assigned: 'curated' = reviewed by a qualified SE; 'inferred' = derived by automated keyword matching.

fmea_revision_date.description: Most recent FMEA revision timestamp for this failure mode, if tracked in the KG.

revision_date.description: Fallback revision timestamp field used by some KG populations.

failure_mechanism.description: Physical mechanism (e.g., fatigue, corrosion, wear, overload).

expected_symptom_types.description: Expected symptom types — matched against event.json symptom_signature.symptom_types.

expected_symptoms.description: Alias for expected_symptom_types used by some runtime paths.

expected_anomaly_pattern.description: Expected telemetry pattern — matched against telemetry_summary anomaly patterns.

expected_latency_min_hours.description: Minimum expected failure progression time in hours (from FMEA).

expected_latency_max_hours.description: Maximum expected failure progression time in hours (from FMEA).

fmea_source_ref.description: Source FMEA document or node reference.

rpn.description: Risk Priority Number from FMEA, if available.

documents_in_neighborhood.description: CR/WO/SOP/ECA document nodes linked to components in the subgraph. Defines the valid document scope for evidence_bundle retrieval.

link_type.description: KG edge type connecting document to component (e.g., DESCRIBES, CORRECTS, GOVERNS).

documents.description: Documents linked to components in the subgraph. Used for evidence prior scoring and retrieval scoping.

time_distance_days.description: Days between document creation and the current event. Used for evidence recency scoring.

matched_asset_ids.description: Asset IDs this document is linked to in the KG.

matched_component_ids.description: Component IDs this document is linked to in the KG.

priority_score.description: Retrieval priority score for this document.

safety_functions.description: Safety functions performed by components in the subgraph. Used to assess which safety functions could be impacted by each causal candidate.

sf_id.description: Safety function node ID in the KG.

component_ids.description: Component IDs in the subgraph that perform or support this safety function.

past_events.description: Prior abnormal_event nodes in the KG on the same asset or subgraph components.

time_distance_days.description: Days between this past event and the current event.

priority_score.description: Composite relevance score: asset/component/FM match bonuses + recency term. Computed by orchestrator.

fm_id.description: Failure mode linked to this past event, if established.

in_precursor_window.description: True when days_before_current_event <= precursor_window_days config (default 180). Null when timestamp unavailable.

window_tier.description: Temporal proximity tier: primary (<=precursor_window_days), extended (<=2x), historical (beyond), unknown (no timestamp).

out_of_boundary_anomalies.description: Stage-B temporal prefilter anomalies/components outside strict neighborhood; can be used by Stage-C temporal governance.

seed_context.description: Runtime seeding/provenance used by the current orchestrator during development.

provenance.description: Builder provenance: who/what generated this kg_context and with which run_id.
